subject.title: feat: add jsonl support to memory indexer

question: Should arbitrary JSONL files from memorySearch.extraPaths become a supported builtin memory source, or should raw structured logs remain behind session-memory or an external converter/plugin?
rationale: The existing product separates curated Markdown memory from opt-in, sanitized, visibility-filtered session transcripts; accepting arbitrary JSONL requires a schema and privacy contract that source inspection cannot choose.

options.title: Keep builtin Markdown-focused
options.body: Document the converter and session-memory paths, and direct custom structured-log schemas to a plugin.

options.title: Approve typed JSONL ingestion
options.body: Define one supported record schema and privacy model, then add complete ingestion and retrieval support without accepting arbitrary unknown JSONL records.

recommendation.title: Keep builtin Markdown-focused
recommendation.body: Document the converter and session-memory paths, and direct custom structured-log schemas to a plugin.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository explicitly routes Memory and QMD ownership to this person, and the decision spans builtin memory and the existing alternatives.
